BR-44
BRAKE - PARKING BRAKE
7. REMOVE REAR SHOE
(a) Using SST, remove the shoe hold-down spring and pin
from the rear shoe.
SST 09718-00010
(b) Disconnect the rear shoe from the parking brake shoe le­
ver, and remove rear shoe.
8. REMOVE PARKING BRAKE SHOE LEVER
Using needle-nose pliers, disconnect the parking brake cable
from the parking brake shoe lever.
